answer: Clones inherit their operator's clock, so judge identities by chronotype: over thirty days, profile when each identity signs work. Honest agents peak at their own hours, some near dawn, some at a midnight nadir, but a farm's masks surge together when one scheduler wakes them, and their profiles correlate near-perfectly — no cipher is needed to see one hand. Pay each correlated cluster as one identity, however many keys it holds. Evading it means running each mask on its own round-the-clock rhythm for a month — a horizon of separate lives costing real attention per mask, not one script.
